game.title: Red Faction: Armageddon
game.blurb: Third-person shooter set on Mars, from Volition (RAWG also lists THQ), published by THQ and THQ Nordic, released 2011-06-07. RAWG average playtime: 2 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters follow the numbered story achievements on Steam, plus chapters drawn from achievement themes.

chapters.title: Story: Into the Terraformer to the Surface
chapters.summary: Story achievements 2 to 10 in the Steam API names: the Terraformer, the Seal, back to civilization, the convoy, the Water Filtration Plant and the surface.

chapters.title: Story: Defending the Red Faction to Escorting Winters
chapters.summary: Story achievements 11 to 16: defending the Red Faction, the Jamming Devices, the Mantis, the Marauder homelands and escorting Winters. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Story: Reaching the Lair to the End
chapters.summary: Story achievements 17 to 21: finding and reaching the lair, the secret entrance and the end of the story. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Hard and Insane
chapters.summary: Finishing the single-player game on Hard and on Insane.

chapters.title: Path to War
chapters.summary: The ten achievements marked "Path to War DLC Only", including the Shard Cannon, the Sharpshooter and Mallus.

chapters.title: Infestation
chapters.summary: Waves 10, 20 and 30, every map, revives and a perfect four-player game.

chapters.title: Vehicles and Walkers
chapters.summary: The L.E.O. exoskeleton, the Marauder Scout Walker, the Inferno GX and the Mantis.

chapters.title: Salvage, Upgrades and Audio Logs
chapters.summary: Salvage piles, total salvage, Upgrade rings, every Upgrade, buying a Cheat and 40 Audio Logs.

chapters.title: Weapons, Nano Powers and Combat
chapters.summary: Impact, Shockwave, Berserk and Shell, the Magnet Gun, the Maul, Creepers, Berserkers and Wraiths.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 4523). The Steam store list has one match, app 55110 ("Red Faction®: Armageddon™"); its schema is named "ValveTestApp55110" (a placeholder name) and has 58 achievements, none hidden. StrategyWiki has no page under "Red Faction: Armageddon" or "Red Faction Armageddon". redfaction.fandom.com answers the API under "Red Faction: Armageddon" with about 95 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The story achievements have API names "Story 2" to "Story 23" (1, 5, 7, 8 and 13 are missing from the list), which give the order; the split into three parts is our own choice. "Story 22" and "Story 23" are the Hard and Insane runs. RAWG lists one addition, "Red Faction: Armageddon - Path to War" (2011-08-02), and ten descriptions say "(Path to War DLC Only)". "Family Business" (Defeat the Mantis, Story 14) sits in the story, while "Exterminator" (pods while piloting the Mantis) sits with vehicles.
